business_summary: Xinjiang Tianye Water Saving Irrigation System Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and sells water-savings products in China. The company offers drip films, tapes, and assemblies, as well as PVC and PE piping materials and accessories. It also engages in the provision of installation services for water saving irrigation systems; land circulation and engineering businesses; development of digital agriculture and agriculture services; and trading activities. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Shihezi, China. Xinjiang Tianye Water Saving Irrigation System Company Limited is a subsidiary of Xinjiang Tianze Water Conservancy Investment and Development Co., Ltd.
business_summary_ko: Xinjiang Tianye Water Saving Irrigation System Company Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국에서 물 절약 제품을 설계, 제조 및 판매합니다. 이 회사는 드립 필름, 테이프, 어셈블리뿐만 아니라 PVC 및 PE 배관 재료와 액세서리도 제공합니다. 또한 물 절약형 관개 시스템 설치 서비스 제공에도 참여합니다. 토지 순환 및 엔지니어링 사업; 디지털 농업 및 농업 서비스 개발; 및 거래 활동. 이 회사는 1999년에 설립되었으며 중국 스허쯔(Shihezi)에 본사를 두고 있습니다. Xinjiang Tianye Water Saving Irrigation System Company Limited는 Xinjiang Tianze Water Conservancy Investment and Development Co., Ltd.의 자회사입니다.
